summary: Swiss seal group (900 staff, EUR 247 M), sole source of our ATEX drinking-water cartridge seal; we are 0.17 % of its turnover. Head office froze all price reductions until December 2027 and quotes list price only; pricing committee above 2 %. Excellent quality (0 ppm, OTD 96-100 %). Price is 16.6 % over the should-cost of its plant. Open on payment terms and call-off flexibility: take value there, open moderate.
notes: Wants price stability and to keep a frozen list; never got an increase from us (asked +1.3-3.3 %, settled 0). Contradiction: March note says committee approves changes above 2 %, August note and quote say no reductions at all. Contract auto-extended to 2027 (180-day notice passed). Hard to replace: drinking-water approvals.

Cite the should-cost of its plant once as the main price argument.
If price will not move, take value in longer payment terms (30 to 60 days) and call-off flexibility.

Accept a reasonable final offer; it is sole source with no approved alternative.
